title: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre Recruitment 2026 – Lab Attendant, Clerk Posts
shortInfo: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre has announced notification for Lab Attendant, Clerk posts. Required qualification: BCA, 10TH, Diploma, B.Sc, Any Graduate. Last date to apply: 05-10-26.
howToApply: Download the prescribed application form from the PRSC website: https://prsc.punjab.gov.in
Fill in the application form completely in all respects.
Attach all required certificates, testimonials, and supporting documents related to qualifications and experience.

Pay the non-refundable application fee via Online transfer or Demand Draft in favor of ‘Director, Punjab Remote Sensing Centre’ payable at Ludhiana. Account No. 32430207442, State Bank of India, PAU Ludhiana, IFSC Code: SBIN0001482.
If fee is deposited online, mention the Receipt/UTR/Acknowledgment Number in the application form and attach proof of fee deposited.
Submit the completed application form along with documents and fee by Registered/Speed Post or by hand to: The Director, Punjab Remote Sensing Centre (PRSC), PAU Campus, Ludhiana-141 004.
If already employed, apply through proper channel or produce a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the present employer. An advance copy with testimonials may be sent.
Applications must reach the office on or before 05.10.2026.

title: DLSA Sangrur Recruitment 2026 – Para Legal Volunteer Posts
shortInfo: DLSA Sangrur has announced notification for Para Legal Volunteer posts. Required qualification: Other. Last date to apply: 05-10-26.
howToApply: Obtain the prescribed proforma (application form) for Para Legal Volunteer.

Fill in all required details including name, father/mother’s name, date of birth, category, residential address, correspondence address, educational qualifications, work area, experience, preferred work location (District/Sub-Division), mobile number, and email ID.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents (category certificate, address proof, educational qualification certificates, experience certificate if any).
Affix a self-attested photograph at the designated place on the form.
Sign the declaration stating no civil or criminal case is pending and that you are not an active political enthusiast of any political party.
Submit the completed application form along with all attachments to the office of District Legal Services Authority, Samjhauta Sadan, Sangrur before 4:00 PM on 05/10/2026.

title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.
